title: Research sprint goal: Live agent view, first slice: follow one session's transcript in a terminal
goal: The sprint goal's open questions are answered with the kb tools first and the live docs for the gaps: (1) Where does Claude Code keep a session's main transcript and a subagent's transcript, and how is the project folder of a working directory named? (2) Is the transcript entry format internal to Claude Code, so a script that parses transcript files can break on any release? (3) Which interfaces does Claude Code document for a script to read a session's structured data?
notes: No outside facts: the kb answers each question with coverage good (public/claude/hooks.md:51 subagent transcripts in <session>/subagents/agent-<id>.jsonl; hooks.md:54 projects/<slug>/<session-id>.jsonl, slug = path with non-alphanumerics as '-', entry format internal and changing between versions; hooks.md:56 stream-json, --resume, transcript_path and the Agent SDK as the documented interfaces), checked by kb_pack on 2026-10-26.
